UNITED STATES ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY REGION I
J.F. KENNEDY FEDERAL BUILDING, BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS 02203
December 3, 1975
Mr. William H. Hernandez, Jr.
Area Director
Department of Housing and Urban Development
15 New Chardon Street
Boston, MA 02114
RE: D-HUD-B89006-MA
Dear Mr. Hernandez:
We have completed our review of the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Clearance of Unsafe Buildings in the City of Boston. Our review indicated that the Impact Statement presented an excellent assessment of all affected program responsibilities within EPA.
We have, therefore, rated the Statement LO-1 in accordance with our national rating system, a copy of which is enclosed.
We thank you for allowing us time to review the statement, and we would like to receive a copy of the Final Statement to complete our files.
Sincerely yours,
Wallace E. Stickney, P.E.
Director
Environmental Impact Office
cc: City of Boston
Enclosure
